# Lex Agraria & Civitas Franchise (《农地与罗马市民权法（Lex Agraria & Civitas）》)
oe_spqr_pi_lex_agraria_civitas = {
	type = country
	estate = peasants_estate

	modifier_when_in_debate = {
		global_pop_assimilation_speed_modifier = 0.12
	}

	potential = {
		OR = {
			parliament_type = parliament_type:oe_spqr_senate
			oe_spqr_is_republic_host = yes
		}
	}

	allow = {
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_spqr_mod_pi_lex_agraria }
	}

	chance = {
		add = 8
		add = {
			if = {
				limit = { parliament_type = parliament_type:oe_spqr_senate }
				value = 5
			}
		}
		add = {
			if = {
				limit = { at_war = no }
				value = 3
			}
		}
	}

	wants_this_parliament_issue_bias = {
		add = 6
		add = {
			if = {
				limit = { at_war = no }
				value = 10
			}
		}
	}

	on_debate_passed = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_spqr_mod_pi_lex_agraria years = 12 mode = replace }
		add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = estate_satisfaction_weak_bonus }
		add_republican_tradition = republican_tradition_weak_bonus
	}

	on_debate_failed = {
		parliament_debate_failed_effect = yes
	}
}

		}

				value = 5
			}
		}
		add = {
			if = {
				limit = { num_locations >= 8 }

			}

	}

	wants_this_parliament_issue_bias = {
